title: Safeguarding Coordinator
description:
CONTEXT
The Operations Department of MSF OCB (Operational Centre Brussels) consists of 8 managerial and technical teams called Cells, each in charge of a portfolio of countries and 1 Emergency Team (E-Pool) for the management of intense emergency interventions. These teams directly supervise and support the programme/ project implementation.
Cell 5 is a team of 7 persons based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil and a regional pharmacy advisor working remotely. The countries currently managed by the Cell 5 are: Haiti, Brazil, Venezuela and Dominican Republic.
As the Safeguarding Coordinator LATAM, you will be under the hierarchical supervision of the Coordinator of Operations (CO) and under the functional management of the Safeguarding Unit at MSF OCB. Given the specialized and focused approach of this position, you will closely collaborate with members of the Cell, the Country and Project Coordinators. You will mentor project management teams in preventing and detecting all forms of abuse in the region and develop the OCB Safeguarding strategy across all LATAM programs to create a safe environment for staff, patients, and the community.
You will support the program in implementing the Safeguarding mitigation plan at program and project level, aimed at reducing the risks of safeguarding abuse of individuals in the country operations/projects where you are deployed. You will work closely and across the board with all country and project teams, reporting directly to the CO.
MAIN OBJECTIVE
This position is focused on:
Promoting MSF OCB's working culture to be more aligned with MSF OCB's safeguarding values and principles, framework and commitment to a zero-tolerance approach
Detecting and preventing risks of safeguarding abuse in our working and care environments in Brazil, Venezuela and Haiti
Given the size of the operation and sensitivities in the context, and the fact that this position is new to MSF, a multi-year approach and strategic plan will be necessary to fulfill the aims of the position.
MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Safeguarding Framework
Adapt and implement MSF safeguarding framework in LATAM
Conduct risk assessments and context analyses; integrate lessons from past cases
Improve staff complaint mechanisms and establish safe, confidential community feedback systems
2. Procedures and HR Integration
Ensure Behavioural Commitments are signed, explained, and integrated during recruitment
Provide safeguarding briefings and induction for all staff and partners
Advise HR on safe recruitment practices and assess framework implementation
3. Awareness and Training
Raise awareness among senior staff on safeguarding roles and responsibilities
Design culturally appropriate materials and activities for staff, patients, and communities
Deliver training on abuse prevention topics and facilitate Training of Trainers (TOT) sessions
Define sustainable plans for refresher sessions and ongoing discussions
4. Collaboration and Capacity Building
Conduct regular project visits and participate in safeguarding networks and forums
Lead safeguarding discussions with CO, HRO, and country teams
Build staff capacity and supervise safeguarding implementation
Support programme design and emergency responses with safeguarding risk assessments
Integrate safeguarding objectives into departmental plans and document lessons learned
Support medical teams to uphold patient rights and integrate safeguarding into service delivery
Champion diversity, equality, inclusion, and anti-racism principles
REQUIREMENTS
Education & Experience
Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field (e.g. law, social or organizational sciences, gender, social work, anti-discrimination, whistleblowing, etc.) is mandatory
Experience in safeguarding / abuse prevention in an international organization is mandatory
Humanitarian experience, preferably in the health sector, is mandatory
MSF experience is a strong asset
Experience in facilitation, adult learning, and coordination of trainings and workshops is an asset
Experience working in fast-paced, high-risk multicultural environments is an asset
Professional experience in the region (LATAM) is an asset
Competencies
Teamwork and cooperation
Analytical thinking
Networking, monitoring and reporting
Creativity and contextual sensitivity when engaging on behavioural expectations
Ability to handle highly sensitive situations and confidential information diplomatically, discreetly, and securely
Ability to engage communities and patients and staff in a sensitive, culturally appropriate manner is mandatory
Excellent listening and verbal communication skills
Stress management
Strong IT skills (Microsoft 365 tools)
Languages
Proficiency in English both written and spoken is mandatory
Fluency in Spanish and French is required
Fluency in Portuguese is an asset
CONDITIONS
Expected starting date: as soon as possible
Location: based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
Contract type: Fixed-term contract – full-time
Contract duration: 12 months (extendable)
Mobility: at least 50% travel within the region
Salary according to MSF salary grid
The contractual terms and salary will be established according to the official residence of the selected candidate and in compliance with the standard MSF function and salary grids
Not family posting
Adhere to the MSF principles and to our managerial values: Respect, Transparency, Integrity, Accountability, Trust and Empowerment
Adhere to the MSF Behavioural Commitments
Deadline for applications: 28th of January 2026
Female applicants are strongly encouraged to apply
How to apply?
➢ Submit your application via the 'Apply here' button on the vacancy page
➢ You will be directed to the online application form for this position
➢ It should take 5-10 minutes to complete. Thank you in advance for having your CV and motivation letter, in PDF format ready to upload
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
MSF values diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of disability, gender identity, marital or civil partnership status, race, color or ethnic and national origins, religion or belief, or sexual orientation.

  • Linguagem e Afeto: Conversar, cantar, fazer caretas e criar um ambiente de confiança e carinho.

title: Senior Media Services Manager
description:
Department: Broadcast & Media Operations
Location: Brazil
Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
Responsible for the successful implementation of the Media Services at the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027.
Media Operations & Services is a very important function in the organisation, as this area is providing the services and conditions for all media to report about the competition to millions of viewers, listeners and readers around the world.
Reporting organisationally to the Head of Media Operations & Services, the Senior Media Services Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team, and work in close collaboration with Accreditation, Accommodation, Transport, Catering, Venue Management, Media partnerships, Host City Rights Management and other key individuals responsible for planning, delivering and managing Media services for the more than 2000 national and international media expected to attend the FIFA Women's World Cup. Success with this project will contribute favourably to the positive outcome of the Women's Football Strategy
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Support to implement a comprehensive media servicing strategy for all Brazil host cities of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027.
Ensure consistent delivery of services across various tournament venues, ensuring a standardised experience for all media professionals.
Support to define an efficient visa strategy and implementation of visa procedure for media representatives.
Coordinate with logistics to define appropriate custom procedures for media representatives to bring professional equipment in and out of the host country.
Support the accreditation process in collaboration with the FIFA Zurich Media Operations & Services team and the Accreditation team.
Plan transport services for media representatives across all tournament venues.
Support FIFA Zurich HQ to coordinate media Accommodation options and scope services linked to it in collaboration with Media partnership
Support in the implementation of Media Ticketing.
Support in facilitating a seamless integration between media operations and media services, optimising workflows to deliver the highest level of support and services to accredited media representatives.
Support to create a uniformed pricing strategy for catering services.
Support to create inventive and budget-conscious media gift and incentive ideas tailored for accredited media representatives.
YOUR PROFILE
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent
Higher education qualification in media or sports event management
5+ years' experience in the sports industry, with an emphasis on media and broadcast operations
5-7 years' experience in sports project management, preferably in football
Fluent in English, Portuguese, Spanish and/or French proficiency is a plus
Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools
Right to work in Brazil.
Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Why join TCS?
Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.
We are looking for a SAP PMO who wants to learn and transform their career. In this role is responsible for managing the governance, processes, and resources for SAP projects, ensuring successful delivery by overseeing planning, execution, risk management, stakeholder communication, and adherence to methodologies. The SAP PMO ensures that all projects—whether software, infrastructure, or process-related—follow the same methodology, use the same tools, and report indicators in a standardized way, providing consolidated visibility to senior management.
In this role, you will:
• Standardize Methodologies: Define and update the project management "toolkit" (schedule templates, communication plans, risk matrices) to be used by all Project Managers.
• Governance and Compliance: Ensure that projects follow approval phases and internal processes, guaranteeing compliance with company standards.
• Report Consolidation (Dashboards): Gather data from multiple projects to create executive reports on status, timelines, and overall portfolio health (with no focus on costs).
• Resource and Capacity Management (Capacity Planning): Monitor team workload to identify staffing bottlenecks and help prioritize which project should start first.
• Support and Mentorship: Assist Project Managers and Product Owners in resolving methodological conflicts and using management tools.
• Corporate Risk Management: Identify risks that recur across multiple projects and propose structural actions to eliminate them at their source.
• Continuous Improvement: Analyze lessons learned from completed projects to optimize workflows for future cycles.

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, IT, or related fields.

• Diplomacy and Impartiality: Skill in auditing projects and pointing out deviations constructively and neutrally.
• Analytical Vision: Ability to identify failure patterns in schedules before they become critical issues.
• Teaching Ability: Skill in training others and explaining methodologies in a simple and applicable way.

title: Técnico de segurança do trabalho
description:
Descrição da vaga:

Estamos em busca de um Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho organizado, analítico e comprometido com a saúde e segurança no ambiente corporativo. O profissional ideal possui habilidades técnicas e comportamentais que garantam a execução eficiente de tarefas relacionadas à gestão de SST, além de colaborar com a equipe para promover um ambiente de trabalho seguro e em conformidade com a legislação vigente.

Horário de Trabalho:

  • Segunda a quinta-feira: 07h às 17h
  • Sexta-feira: 07h às 16h
  • Carga horária semanal: 44h (220h mensais).

Descrição da função:

  • Apoiar no levantamento de dados e na organização de informações técnicas para elaboração, renovação e atualização de laudos (LTI, LTP, LTCAT);
  • Elaborar, revisar e manter atualizados os documentos legais obrigatórios de SST, como PGR, PCMSO, PPP, PCA, PPR, entre outros;
  • Controlar prazos de validade de documentos e laudos, assegurando sua conformidade com as exigências legais;
  • Atuar na gestão documental e no arquivamento físico e digital de registros relacionados à Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho;
  • Dar suporte em auditorias internas e externas, organizando evidências e documentações exigidas;
  • Desenvolver relatórios, planilhas e indicadores gerenciais voltados para a área de SST;
  • Apoiar na comunicação com fornecedores de serviços técnicos e na coleta de informações para contratos e relatórios;
  • Contribuir com a padronização e melhoria contínua dos processos administrativos relacionados à SST.

Requisitos:

  • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho completo, com registro ativo no MTE;
  • Experiência anterior com foco em rotinas administrativas da área de SST;
  • Conhecimento prático em elaboração de documentos legais e laudos técnicos;

title: Process Eng.
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.
Overview:
We are seeking a Process Engineer with extensive hands-on expertise in Sulfur Recovery Unit (SRU) and Sour Water Stripper (SWS) processes to join our Operation Engineering Solutions Department (OESD).
OESD's technical team is responsible for providing high-quality, multi-disciplinary support to Global Manufacturing operating facilities (Refineries, NGLF, and petrochemical plants) within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and globally.
Your primary role is to provide in-depth process engineering and operations expertise to monitor, optimize, and drive performance improvement programs for refineries' SRU & SWS, including remote and on-site technical advisory support, benchmarking, and technology knowledge management.
Key Responsibilities:
As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Conduct regular performance reviews of existing SRU & SWS facilities and analyze KPIs related to operability, profitability, reliability, and process safety.
Develop and present quarterly benchmarking reports with actionable improvement recommendations.
Provide hands-on support in implementing performance improvement initiatives, demonstrating measurable results in closing identified gaps.
Lead benchmarking and best practices exchange workshops among Global Manufacturing facilities, facilitating knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
Develop and distribute bi-monthly SRU & SWS technical best practices bulletins, ensuring knowledge dissemination across Global Manufacturing facilities.
Deliver on-demand remote and field technical advisory support, including troubleshooting, start-up/shutdown activities, capacity test runs, and technology pilot testing and provide detailed service reports for each support activity.
Collaborate with Global Manufacturing facilities engineers to identify and implement cost optimization and process improvement initiatives, focusing on "low-hanging fruits" that require minimal capital investment.
Conduct internal assessments of SRU & SWS process engineering standards, ensuring alignment with Saudi Aramco engineering standards and supporting their implementation across Global Manufacturing facilities.
Participate in Business Plan development, coordinating with stakeholders on capital investments for SRU & SWS units and supporting techno-economic evaluations.
Evaluate and recommend new SRU & SWS technologies and coordinate with relevant departments for assessment and piloting support.
Actively participate in external benchmarking activities with industry bodies such as Japan Cooperation Council Petroleum (JCCP) and Gulf Downstream Association (GDA).
Minimum Requirements:
You will hold a Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering or related specialization. An advanced degree is preferred.
A minimum of 15 years of total refinery or gas plants process units experience, with at least 10 years of hands-on experience in handling SRUs/TGTU/SWS plants.
You will be able to optimize SRU & SWS operations, with specific examples of performance improvements achieved.
You will have in-depth knowledge of SRU/TGTU process licensor technologies.
You will have a proven track record of conducting technical troubleshooting, start-up, shutdown, and capacity test runs for SRU & SWS units.
You will have strong proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools specific to SRU & SWS performance metrics.
You will have strong management and coordination skills, with experience in stakeholder management
You will also have excellent computer and presentation skills.
Working environment:
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

You will ensure the delivery of actionable intelligence to each customer's security or operational environments in order to drive decision-making and action. You will also acts as a conduit to Mandiant's extensive network of cyber security, threat intelligence, and information operations professionals.
Part of Google Cloud, Mandiant is a recognized leader in dynamic cyber defense, threat intelligence and incident response services. Mandiant's cybersecurity expertise has earned the trust of security professionals and company executives around the world. Our unique combination of renowned frontline experience responding to some of the most complex breaches, nation-state grade threat intelligence, machine intelligence, and the industry's best security validation ensures that Mandiant knows more about today's advanced threats than anyone.

Generate CTI, and perform analysis of customer data, taking their bespoke sources to identify threat activity, or to build and automate workflows.

title: Vice President, Business Development
description:
Job Description
The Vice President Business Development individually drives market position and achievement of business outcomes through the Demand and Account Management/Commercial Operations Core Process. This position is a senior level, core sales position within the company responsible for new business/clients as well as managing/leveraging existing accounts. The Vice President Business Development drives results through individual and collective team sales efforts. The position is responsible for leveraging collaboration with internal teams such as marketing, engineering/survey, and product development and technology groups in order to drive service and business outcomes. The Vice President Business Development also contributes to strategic initiatives and planning through an extensive knowledge of market conditions within their assigned specific location or group of locations, country or group of countries, market sector, and/or product(s).
What You Will Do:
Execute and drive sales strategies in the assigned area of responsibility and meet or exceed sales and revenue targets with a focus on the marine area.
Support the Product & Digital Solution Development, Survey & Certification, Engineering Delivery, and Rule Development Core Processes as needed to achieve organizational business outcomes.
Develop and maintain key client relationships with a focus on maintaining current work and expanding new business opportunities and prospect for new clients and business opportunities within your assigned responsibility in marine sector
Lead the development of visit plans for assigned clients and area of responsibility, to include organizing client meetings for ABS senior management
Execute the Demand and Account Management / Commercial Operations Core Process as appropriate within the assigned area of responsibility
Maintains awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate, ensuring peers and teams outside your core responsibility are aware of potential opportunities and needed action
Provide strategic insight within the assigned area or responsibility related to future business initiatives, market drivers, and competitor activities for inclusion in business planning
Work with organizational teams to develop capture strategies, proposals and pricing as appropriate
Work with technical staff and other internal teams as needed to meet customer needs.
Attend industry events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends.
Identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales.
Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company's CRM
Forecast sales targets and track activity on accounts to meet these targets
What You Will Need:
Education and Experience
Bachelor's degree in business or in an engineering technical field is required
MBA or engineering postgraduate degree is preferred
Over 20 years of experience in marine sector
Typically 7 or more years of experience in the assigned area of responsibility or market sector is required
International experience, either as an expatriate or working with international projects and teams, is required
Previous experience in business development or sales in a technical and diverse product environment is preferred
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
Demonstrated acumen for sales, business development, and account management with experience in meeting and/or exceeding sales targets preferred
Demonstrated proficiency in developing strategic customer relationships.
Strong leadership presence and the ability to quickly establish and build credibility and relationships, externally as well as internally to ABS
Excellent business judgment, including the ability to assess the reasonableness and likelihood of success of various business scenarios
Demonstrated technical acumen related to the product or area of responsibility
A self-starter with a demonstrated desire achieve goals and as well as a collaborative personality who effectively works with teams and individuals to achieve organizational business outcomes
Reporting Relationships:
Reports directly to the Senior Vice President
About Us
We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.
ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We're at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.
Equal Opportunity
ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.
Other

title: Analista de Operações de Airbnb
description:
Se você é do tipo que gosta de
aprender rápido, resolver problemas no dia a dia e atuar próximo da operação

Nossa cultura e o que buscamos

A Catete Apartments é uma das empresas líderes em administração de imóveis de temporada no Rio de Janeiro, com mais de 100 propriedades e mais de 1 milhão de visualizações mensais nas redes sociais. Crescemos 3x nos últimos 12 meses e queremos continuar expandindo com qualidade.

Por isso, é fundamental que a pessoa nesse cargo incorpore nossos valores — Encantar, Entregar, Resolver e Colaborar. Como Analista de Operações de Airbnb, você representa a Catete Apartments para toda a nossa equipe de campo e para cada hóspede que se hospeda nos nossos imóveis. Você terá a oportunidade (e a responsabilidade) de garantir que cada experiência seja melhor do que a anterior.

Seus principais desafios:

  • Realizar vistorias em campo para avaliar a qualidade das limpezas e o estado geral das propriedades.
  • Entregar feedback constante ao time de arrumadeiras, promovendo a melhoria contínua.
  • Definir e coordenar as limpezas diárias em um ambiente dinâmico, com múltiplas demandas acontecendo ao mesmo tempo.
  • Coordenar reparos e manutenções com prestadores e técnicos parceiros.
  • Controlar caixa e fazer prestação de contas de despesas operacionais.
  • Utilizar softwares de gestão (Hostaway, Conduit, Airbnb, planilhas, ferramentas internas) para administrar processos e informações.
  • Manter comunicação constante com outras áreas para assegurar alinhamento operacional.
  • Produzir relatórios periódicos para a diretoria.

Expectativas para os primeiros 6 meses

  • Elevar a nota média das avaliações do Airbnb
    de 4,8 para 4,9.
  • Consolidar um time de campo de alto desempenho.
  • Garantir que todos os apartamentos estejam 100% prontos para cada estadia, sem falhas de manutenção ou enxoval.

O que oferecemos

  • Salário mensal de R$4.500,00 PJ.
  • Bônus por desempenho.
  • Treinamento e reporte direto às sócias da empresa.
  • Crescimento rápido conforme performance.
  • Cultura inovadora, com abertura para implementar ideias e processos.

Jornada de trabalho

  • Trabalho presencial no Catete, Rio de Janeiro
  • Segunda a sexta: 9h às 18h
  • Domingos alternados

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa ou em andamento (áreas administrativas, operacionais, turismo ou correlatas)..
  • Pelo menos 2 anos de experiência prévia em operações, processos ou coordenação de equipes.
  • Facilidade com ferramentas digitais.
  • Boa comunicação, organização e atenção a detalhes.
  • Capacidade de adaptação a mudanças e de autogestão.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

title: Especialista de Inteligência de Mercado
description:
Hydro Energia é uma empresa integrada de alumínio e energia com presença global, incluindo o Brasil. A Hydro Energia atua como uma comercializadora independente de energia elétrica, oferecendo serviços como gestão e otimização de portfólio de energia, consultoria regulatória e comercial, além de operações estruturadas no mercado de energia. No Brasil, a empresa tem escritórios em Belém e no Rio de Janeiro e é uma das maiores operadoras no mercado livre de energia no Norte do país. Aqui fazemos mais do que conectar energia: conectamos ideias, inovação e sustentabilidade. Nosso compromisso é construir um futuro energético mais eficiente, sustentável e inteligente.

O que oferecemos a você


Salário competitivo com o Mercado de Energia, com um pacote abrangente de benefícios, garantindo que você seja recompensado pelas suas contribuições.
A oportunidade de se juntar a equipes diversas em uma empresa líder global em alumínio e energias renováveis que está mudando o jogo do alumínio.
Um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, criativo, com projetos globais e ambições sustentáveis.
Oportunidade de moldar a função e crescer na carreira por meio do desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal.
Você será parte de um negócio para o futuro juntando-se a nós em uma jornada transformadora.

O que você fará

  • Liderar tecnicamente e executar o processo de previsão de preços de energia de curto e médio prazo, promovendo sua evolução contínua e garantindo consistência metodológica, robustez analítica e qualidade dos resultados;
  • Atuar como assessor técnico da mesa de trading, fornecendo análises, cenários e recomendações para posicionamento e mitigação de riscos;
  • Acompanhar e participar ativamente de fóruns, reuniões e grupos de trabalho do Operador Nacional do Sistema Elétrico (ONS) e da Câmara de Comercialização de Energia Elétrica (CCEE) relacionados à formação do Preço de Liquidação das Diferenças (PLD), bem como monitorar regulação, notas técnicas e consultas públicas sobre o tema, antecipando potenciais impactos nos preços e nas estratégias comerciais da empresa;
  • Desenvolver, estruturar e evoluir processos automatizados, códigos e modelos internos associados à previsão de preços de curto e médio prazo (modelos principais e/ou satélites), assegurando atualização metodológica contínua, rastreabilidade e eficiência computacional;
  • Planejar e conduzir estudos complexos sobre formação de preços, avaliação de riscos e drivers estruturais do setor elétrico (expansão da geração, limites de transmissão, projeção de demanda, entre outros).

O que fará você ter sucesso?


Formação Acadêmica

  • Superior completo em Engenharia, Economia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas;
  • Desejável Mestrado em Otimização, Planejamento Energético, Modelagem Quantitativa ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos e Habilidades

  • Experiência no mercado de energia elétrica;
  • Conhecimento dos modelos computacionais Newave, Decomp e Dessem;
  • Inglês avançado para conversação, escrita e leitura;
  • Pacote Office avançado;
  • Nível avançado em programação (necessário conhecimento de Python);
  • Nível avançado em ferramentas de Business Intelligence (preferencialmente Power BI);
  • Desejável conhecimento de técnicas avançadas de estatística e machine learning.

Perfil

  • Liderança técnica em modelagem e previsão de preços de energia;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e visão quantitativa;
  • Pensamento crítico para avaliação de modelos e premissas regulatórias;
  • Orientação a risco e suporte estratégico à mesa de trading;
  • Domínio de programação e automação de modelos (Python & BI);
  • Conhecimento aprofundado do setor elétrico e formação de PLD.

A Hydro valoriza diversas habilidades e perspectivas entre os empregados. Encorajamos todas as pessoas qualificadas a se inscreverem. Os perfis aderentes serão considerados independentemente de raça, religião, nacionalidade, etnia, idade, gênero, identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual ou deficiência. Nós nos esforçamos para oferecer oportunidades iguais para que todos possam contribuir e ter sucesso conosco.

Atuação na Norsk Hydro (Rio de Janeiro/RJ ou Belém/PA), podendo ser uma localidade flexível.

Inscrições exclusivamente pelo site da Hydro. No ato da inscrição os Certificados de escolaridade deverão ser anexados. Para maiores informações, visite

Todas as oportunidades estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PCD) e reabilitadas pelo INSS.

Conheça mais sobre os nossos negócios e processos, acesse Hydro Brazil Corporate Video (Extended version) - YouTube.

title: Utility Operator
description:
Join OSM Thome as a Utility Operator onboard an FPSO/FSO operating offshore Vitoria, Brazil. In this role you support safe and efficient daily operations, ensuring utilities and systems run smoothly to keep the unit fully operational.

Key responsibilities:

  • Read and interpret process diagrams (P&ID);

  • Operate, control, and monitor the machinery space and mechanical equipment, utility systems (including power generation and steam facilities), and utility control rooms, with a strong focus on safety, compliance, and efficiency;

  • Assist and participate in meetings related to the operation and maintenance of utility systems, as required;

  • Identify and report deviations from standard operating conditions, and develop and initiate corrective actions;

  • Identify and report utility system issues, mechanical equipment failures, and maintenance requirements;

  • Prepare required reports, maintain records, and ensure proper documentation is kept up to date;

  • Perform first-line maintenance on utility systems and mechanical equipment, including preventive and corrective maintenance activities, in accordance with SAP system requirements;

  • Carry out chemical sampling and analyses in industrial systems in compliance with applicable requirements;

  • Coordinate with other departments to align activities and support preventive and corrective maintenance performed by other disciplines within the utility systems area;

  • Manage and inventory consumables related to utility systems;

  • Control work permits and audit Work Permits (WPs) related to utility systems, in accordance with the Permit to Work System;

  • Attend training sessions relevant to the position's requirements;

  • Provide on-the-job training to colleagues;

  • Act as a member of the Emergency Response Team, if required by the Company;

  • Perform safety-related duties as required by the Ship Security Plan (SSP);

  • Carry out any other tasks as assigned by the Head of Department, including area responsibility and housekeeping duties.

Requirements:

  • Previous offshore / FPSO / FSO or marine experience in a similar utility or rating role;
  • Relevant seafarer documents and offshore certificates valid for Brazil;
  • Good understanding of safety rules and safe working practices;
  • Ability to work in shifts and in offshore conditions;
  • Intermediate English communication skills; teamwork-oriented attitude.

Garantir a integridade operacional e regulatória da empresa por meio do desenvolvimento, monitoramento e aprimoramento contínuo dos controles internos, promovendo a mitigação de riscos e a conformidade com normas internas e externas.

title: Analista de Operações Logísticas
description:
DESCRIPTION


Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria.

Sejam itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes.

A equipe da Amazon Logistics Brasil (AMZL) está procurando uma pessoa Analista de Operações Logísticas para se juntar ao time de EDSP (External Delivery Service Providers), ou seja, as estações de entrega da AMZL operadas por parceiros. Essa pessoa irá atuar como Torre de Controle para essas operações operadas por parceiros, em turno 4x3. As operações serão feitas 7 dias por semana, incluindo feriados; portanto, os Analistas de Operações Logísticas são todos em turno 4x3, separados entre equipe front e back.

Essa pessoa atuará na gestão de estações de entreda dos parceiros logísticos externos para garantir o desempenho e conformidade dos processos desses parceiros. Trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas.

Essa pessoa precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. Parte de suas funções poderão ser realizadas virtualmente, como também auditoria /visitas aos parceiros logísticos in loco.

Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os Amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não celebramos apenas a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, celebramos as diversas formas como trabalhamos. Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para a entrevista ou o processo de integração, avise seu recrutador e ele o conectará à nossa equipe de acomodação.

Key job responsibilities

  • Monitorar diariamente o funcionamento eficiente dos parceiros logísticos, sugerir e implantar melhorias;

  • Criar e acompanhar métricas operacionais com os parceiros logísticos;

  • Analisar dados de várias fontes e identificar tendências relevantes para que, a partir deles, decisões rápidas e importantes ao negócio sejam tomadas;

  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos;

  • Servir de elo entre os stakeholders internos e externos tendo em vista os objetivos, limites, conformidade e privacidade das informações;

  • Mergulhar profundamente nas causas raízes dos problemas operacionais;

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bacharelado em Engenharia, Administração, Operações ou áreas relacionadas.
  • MS Office, com nível avançado em Excel (vlookup, fórmulas avançadas, tabelas dinâmicas, macros).
  • Habilidade para multitarefas, gerenciando vários parceiros simultaneamente com atenção aos detalhes.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos flexíveis incluindo fins de semana e feriados.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens em 10% do tempo.
  • Inglês básico.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Inglês avançado.
  • Experiência em acompanhamento de processos, métricas e resolução de problemas.
  • Experiência em Logística, Transportes.

title: Estagiária de Princing e RGM
description:
Olá

Estamos em busca de uma estagiária para a área de Princing e RGM para atuar no apoio às análises de preços, margens e promoções, auxiliando na construção de relatórios e indicadores de performance.

Esta estagiária irá dar suporte às estratégias de Revenue Growth Management por meio da análise de dados de vendas, mix de produtos e comportamento do consumidor, colaborando com áreas como vendas, marketing e finanças para otimizar receita e rentabilidade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
Principais atividades:

  • Apoiar na análise de preços, margens e rentabilidade dos produtos;
  • Atualizar e organizar tabelas de preços e bases de dados comerciais;
  • Elaborar e acompanhar relatórios e indicadores de performance (vendas, margem, mix, promoções);
  • Auxiliar na avaliação de impactos de reajustes de preços;
  • Apoiar o planejamento, execução e análise de ações promocionais e descontos;
  • Analisar o mix de produtos e canais de venda;
  • Apoiar estudos sobre comportamento do consumidor e sensibilidade a preço;
  • Interagir com áreas como vendas, marketing, finanças e trade marketing;
  • Garantir a qualidade e consistência dos dados utilizados nas análises.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Cursando Graduação em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas, entre o 3º e o 6º período.
  • Interesse por matemática aplicada e raciocínio lógico;
  • Conhecimento básico de Excel, com disposição para aprofundar e evoluir no uso da ferramenta;
  • Perfil organizado, com boa comunicação e capacidade de estruturar e articular ideias;
  • Capacidade analítica para identificar padrões, conectar informações e compreender impactos e relações entre variáveis;
  • Curiosidade intelectual e abertura para aprender, testar hipóteses, revisar conclusões e evoluir a partir de erros.

title: Senior Proposals Specialist
description:
Job Overview:

The Senior Proposals Specialist uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the proposals discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the proposals discipline. The Senior Proposals Specialist solves complex problems and uses discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Proposals Specialist impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the proposals team and other related teams and ensures that they work within the appropriate guidelines and policies.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

General Corporate Responsibilities:

  • Liaise with and support the Corporate Audit function for annual Business Line proposal-related audits
  • Provide departmental strategic initiatives and support the monthly Proposals Key Performance Indicators (KPI) reporting process to EXCOM

Business Line Responsibilities:

  • Review and understand ITT/ITB (Invitation to Tender/Invitation to Bid) Requirements
  • Draft and distribute Summary of Tender Documentation (SOTD) for review
  • Ensure functional nominations of the bid team are established
  • Prepare bid action list per ITT/ITB requirements
  • Co-chair bid kick-off meetings and schedule progress meetings as required
  • Ensure the basis of bid and bid inputs align with strategy and customer requirements
  • Establish and maintain the bid schedule and communicate requirements to all input providers
  • Manage and facilitate bid delivery meetings, the review process, presentations, and associated actions
  • Monitor the progress of the bidding activity to ensure deliverables are successfully achieved for bid submission
  • Develop and ensure challenge skills are integrated throughout the bid review process
  • Set up and maintain a clarification register to log and monitor all pre- and post-bid correspondence
  • Prepare technical/commercial qualifications
  • Ensure the appropriate delivery arrangements have been made and confirmed in advance
  • Assist with client negotiations
  • Develop Lessons Learned for bid submissions and the bid process for wider cascade to the business via the Estimating and Proposals Managers and required close-out actions, if any
  • Accountable for the financial and technical success of the bid or area of bid responsibility

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • 5 years of functional experience and 2 years of Bids & Proposals experience
  • Ability to work as a team member as well as act as a team leader
  • Maintain key competencies associated with the Proposals function
  • Ability to effectively communicate with team members and management
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, Outlook, Access)

title: Accreditation Documentation
description:
Description


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


The Accreditation programme requires clear, consistent, and accurate documentation and training materials to support staff, volunteers, and stakeholders across all venues and operational environments.

The Accreditation Documentation & Training Material Manager plays a central operational role in coordinating, developing, and delivering accreditation documentation and training content that supports consistent accreditation delivery throughout the tournament lifecycle.

Reporting to the FIFA27 Accreditation Senior Manager / Project Lead, the Accreditation Documentation & Training Materials Manager is responsible for the coordination, development, and delivery of accreditation documentation and training materials in support of tournament operations.

Working within established FIFA accreditation policies and frameworks, and in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich Accreditation, Accreditation Operations, Client Group Management, Systems, Security, and Venue teams, the role ensures that accreditation information and training materials are accurate, up‑to‑date, and accessible to all relevant audiences.

This role focuses on content coordination, operational enablement, and quality assurance.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Accreditation Documentation & Content Management:

  • Coordinate the development and maintenance of accreditation documentation for multiple audiences, including management, accreditation staff, volunteers, and external stakeholders.
  • Support the production of accreditation guidelines, manuals, process documents, and instructional materials.
  • Ensure all documentation aligns with approved FIFA accreditation policies, procedures, and terminology.
  • Coordinate reviews, updates, and version control of accreditation materials throughout the project lifecycle.

Training Material Development & Delivery:

  • Coordinate the development and delivery of accreditation training materials across multiple formats (e.g. presentations, instructional videos, train‑the‑trainer content, digital learning tools).
  • Identify the most appropriate media and formats to support different training needs and stakeholder groups.
  • Support the planning and implementation of accreditation training programmes in coordination with Accreditation Operations, Systems and Client Group Management.
  • Review and refine training materials based on feedback from events and tournament operations.

Operational Support & Cross‑Functional Coordination:

  • Support centralised issue resolution processes by ensuring relevant accreditation guidance and reference materials are available and current.
  • Work across Accreditation workstreams to support operational deliverables where documentation or training inputs are required.
  • Support information sharing across workstreams to ensure consistent understanding of accreditation processes and updates.

Quality Assurance & Compliance:

  • Ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency of all accreditation documentation and training materials.
  • Support compliance with data protection, access control, and accreditation governance requirements.
  • Ensure changes to processes or procedures are clearly communicated and reflected across all documentation.

YOUR PROFILE

  • University degree or equivalent in Event Management, Sports Administration, Operations, or a related field.
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in accreditation, event operations, training, documentation, or related roles within major events.
  • Experience working with accreditation or access control systems is an advantage.
  • Experience working in fast‑paced, multicultural environments.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills.
  • Excellent written communication and technical documentation skills.
  • Experience developing training and instructional materials.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and common collaboration and content creation tools.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

title: QC Inspector Water Alternate Gas
description:
QC Inspector Water Alternate Gas (WAG) Manifolds - Brazil
Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (Residential, with travel to Vespasiano/MG)
Contract: 12-Months
Rate: Day Rate (USD)
We are seeking a highly experienced QC Inspector to support fabrication activities for subsea WAG (Water Alternating Gas) manifolds and associated foundations. Based residentially in Rio de Janeiro, this role will oversee contractor quality performance during fabrication, ensuring strict compliance with project specifications, international codes, and HSE standards. This is a senior-level inspection role requiring deep expertise in welding, CRA materials, and advanced NDT techniques within subsea or offshore fabrication environments.
Key Responsibilities
Perform comprehensive welding inspections (before, during, and after welding activities) in accordance with ISO and relevant international codes
Inspect fabrication of WAG manifolds and subsea structures to ensure compliance with specifications and quality requirements
Verify conformance of WPS/PQR documentation and mill certificates
Conduct and oversee advanced NDT techniques including UT, PAUT, RT, MPI, and DPI
Monitor welding of CRA materials including Super Duplex, Inconel 625, Alloy 59, and F22
Identify, report, and manage non-conformities; stop work where required
Participate in root cause analysis and corrective action development
Prepare detailed weekly inspection and quality reports
Liaise closely with site representatives, welding engineers, and materials specialists
Support audits and follow-up on corrective action closure
Ensure full compliance with HSE requirements and quality standards at all times
Candidate Profile
15+ years' experience in welding inspection within subsea, offshore, or oil & gas fabrication
Strong experience with WAG manifolds or subsea production systems preferred
Certified Welding Inspector (CSWIP 3.1 / 3.2 or equivalent CWI certification)
NDT Level 2 certification (UT & PAUT, RT, DPI required)
Extensive experience with CRA materials and advanced welding processes
Strong ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications
Fluent in English (Portuguese is advantageous)
Strong analytical, reporting, and stakeholder communication skills

title: Quantitative Project Manager
description:
M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we've seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems.
Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 USA prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements.
Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA.
Due to our continued growth, we are hiring for a Quantitative Project Manager at M3 Global Research.
About the Business Unit:
M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.
M3 Global Research maintains ISO 20252 and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world-class offerings and support services to their end-client customers throughout multiple industry sectors.
Job Description
The Mission:
The mission of the Quantitative Project Manager is to be a communication and relationship liaison between M3, our clients, and other teams involved in the project's completion. You will directly manage all aspects of each project on time and within budget. This is the ideal role for someone who has experience in international online market research specifically focused on healthcare, sampling, survey recruitment, and collaboration with all teams involved in the project.
Duties include:
Manage international quantitative market research projects through entire project life cycle including all aspects of managing clients, partners, healthcare professional sample, and consumer sample.
Work directly with various teams to setup and test survey links and redirects, prepare and send sample, conduct quality/audit checks, managing respondent inquiries and honorarium and all other components of online research.
Coordinate and lead project kickoff meetings for all assigned studies to ensure all involved parties understand project specifications, client needs, timelines, and responsibilities.
Manage and leverage relationships with vendors to facilitate accurate and timely deliverables, communications, and issue resolution.
Monitor productivity and quality of data collection to produce regular updates and progress reports on project status.
Manage study profitability by monitoring and accounting for all project costs affecting the budget.
Partner with sales team members and operations staff to address issues and/or make recommendations to improve performance on research studies.
Work independently to support international teams outside of normal US business hours.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience preferred.
The candidate must have at least 2-3 years' experience in market research project management, preferably in the medical/healthcare field.
The candidate must be a self-motivated individual with exceptional time management, organizational skills and attention to detail.
The candidate must have well-developed analytical and problem solving skills; ability to quickly solve problems as they present as well as proactively identify and resolve potential issues to avoid escalation. The candidate must have the ability to work autonomously and in a team environment to successfully meet study specific and departmental objectives.
The candidate must have basic math skills and be able to calculate incidence rate, response rate, honoraria amounts, profit, etc.
The candidate must have very strong Microsoft Office skills including Excel, Outlook and Word, and be a quick learner of new technologies/software.
The candidate must have exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
The candidate must have the ability to manage multiple online research projects accurately and on-time in a fast-paced environment where moving deadlines and other changes often occur in real time.
Additional Information
*M3 reserves the right to change this job description to meet the business needs of the organization

title: Business Data Analyst
description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact.  Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.
About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably.  Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose


  • As a Business Data Analyst, you analyze and interpret complex data to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development. Work closely with stakeholders to identify data needs, create reports, and develop data models that drive business performance and optimize operational efficiency. Ensure data accuracy and contribute to the continuous improvement of data processes and tools.

    • Responsibilities


  • Analyze and interpret complex data sets to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify business needs and data requirements, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives.
  • Develop and maintain data models, dashboards, and reports, providing clear and concise visualizations that communicate key findings to stakeholders.
  • Ensure data accuracy and integrity by performing data validation, cleansing, and quality checks, maintaining high standards of data governance.
  • Extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources into analytical tools, ensuring data is prepared and structured for analysis.
  • Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies within data sets, providing insights that drive business process improvements and operational efficiency.
  • Support the development and implementation of data-driven strategies, working closely with business units to optimize performance and achieve key objectives.
  • Present findings and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders, translating complex data insights into understandable and actionable business terms.
  • Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in data analytics, integrating new tools and methodologies to enhance analytical capabilities.
  • Provide training and support to team members and other departments on data analysis techniques and the use of analytical tools, fostering a data-driven culture within the organization.

    • Education


  • Bachelor's degree in data science, business analytics, computer science, statistics, or a related field is required. Certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are highly recommended. Proficiency in data analysis, statistical tools, and business intelligence (BI) platforms is essential. A master's degree in a related field is preferred but not mandatory.

    • Experience


  • Experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field, with demonstrated expertise in analyzing business data to support decision-making processes.
  • Proven experience in collecting, cleaning, and analyzing large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that drive business performance.
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience in using data analysis tools and languages such as SQL, Python, R, or Excel, and proficiency in business intelligence platforms like Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and implement data models, reports, and dashboards that provide actionable insights to stakeholders across the organization.
  • Experience in working closely with business units to understand their data needs, translating business requirements into data-driven solutions that support strategic goals.
  • Proficiency in data visualization techniques, with the ability to present complex data in a clear and compelling manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Knowledge of data governance, data quality management, and best practices for ensuring data integrity and accuracy across systems.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify data-related issues and recommend effective solutions to improve business processes.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including IT, finance, and operations, to support data-driven initiatives.
  • Relevant certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are preferred.

    • Functional Competencies


    Compliance Governance, Risk and Control Analytics and reporting IT Tools and application Cost and budget control Business Partnering Digital savvy Business Acumen Contract Management Management of change application

title: Consultant (Participatory Public Spaces Design Workshops)
description:
Result of Service

The Consultant (Participatory Public Spaces Design Workshops) reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Juiz de Fora, MG, Brazil

Expected duration

Three (3) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. The "Weaving the city: planning with a participatory approach" project is another phase of the "Territories of Citizenship" project, a partnership between the Municipality of Juiz de Fora and UN-Habitat, launched in December 2021. It applied the Quick Participatory Mapping (QPM) methodology across 139 Special Zones of Social Interest (ZEIS) and two rural districts, alongside the development of a comprehensive Socioeconomic Profile of the prioritized areas. In 2023 and 2024, this project was expanded with the creation of the Public Policy Observatory, a platform dedicated to local data production and analysis to support evidence-based decision-making, enhance transparency, and align municipal policies with global sustainable development goals. In 2026, "Weaving the city: planning with a participatory approach" will focus on improving the quality of life of Juiz de Fora's urban area by promoting inclusive public spaces, sustainable practices, and the integration of gender and diversity perspectives. The initiative also aims to strengthen local capacities for the formulation and monitoring of public policies aligned with global sustainable development agendas, while expanding social participation and community engagement in urban management. To properly implement the project and UN-Habitat's mandate in Brazil, a Consultant (Participatory Public Spaces Design Workshops) is required to ensure the effective planning, coordination and implementation of participatory public spaces design workshops in three (03) selected territories in the city of Juiz de Fora. The target audience for the workshops is children aged 7 to 12 years old. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Consultant (Participatory Public Spaces Design Workshops) reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Consultant (Participatory Public Spaces Design Workshops) will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Develop a Detailed Work Plan, outlining objectives, activities, methodologies, expected results, and a timeline, aligned with UN-Habitat guidelines and Juiz de Fora's strategic plans. b) Coordinate and facilitate three participatory urban design workshops with residents and municipal technical staff, ensuring the inclusion of children, girls and women. c) Develop all necessary materials for the workshops, including visual presentations (PowerPoints, posters, handouts), participatory mapping tools, and activity scripts tailored to the target audience. d) Design and apply innovative participatory methodologies, such as Her City Toolbox, placemaking exercises, and co-creation techniques, in line with UN-Habitat global practices for public spaces. e) Conduct a participatory diagnosis of the selected public spaces identifying opportunities for interventions based on technical criteria and community inputs. f) Oversee and monitor the logistical, material, and technical preparation of the workshops, liaising with local teams to ensure feasibility and smooth implementation. g) Document and systematize data, inputs and results generated during the workshops, ensuring clarity, consistency and traceability, in accessible and editable formats. h) Present the results and deliverables to UN-Habitat and local partners through visual, clear, and accessible formats (executive reports, illustrated presentations, posters, short videos, etc.). i) Ensure compliance with UN-Habitat's standards for visibility, data protection, and ethics, respecting the rights, privacy, and representation of community participants. j) Participate in meetings with UN-Habitat teams, the Municipality of Juiz de Fora, and other relevant stakeholders to align expectations and refine the scope of analysis. k) Ensure all content is aligned with UN-Habitat standards, methodologies, and expectations, while maintaining confidentiality and data protection protocols. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Consultant (Participatory Public Spaces Design Workshops) shall assist the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1 – Work Plan and Methodological Proposal for the Participatory Public Spaces Design Workshops Description: The Product 1 must contain: (i) a detailed Work Plan including objectives, timeline, activities, responsibilities, and risk mitigation strategies; (ii) a Methodological Note outlining the participatory design approach for public spaces, aligned with UN-Habitat principles; (iii) guidelines to ensure inclusive participation (children, gender, youth, people with disabilities); and (iv) preliminary analysis of target areas based on existing diagnostics. Expected delivery date: 10 (M(1.1)days after signing the contract. Product 2 – Participatory Public Spaces Design Workshops Reports Description: The Product 2 must contain: (i) full documentation of the three workshops held in Juiz de Fora, including materials used, group activity summaries, and participatory mapping results; (ii) characterization of addressed territories, participants and public spaces; (iii) lessons learned and recommendations for future stages and replication; (iv) institutional and community feedback and presentation of results to the Municipality and the project's monitoring committee. Expected delivery date: 60 days after signing the contract.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Bachelor's degree in Education, Social Sciences, Psychology, Pedagogy or related fields is required, or additional three (03) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Desirable:
• Postgraduate degree or specialized training in participatory methodologies, urban studies, childhood studies, gender studies, or community development or related fields is desired. Work experience:
• Minimum four (4) years of professional experience providing technical support for the development of participatory urban design projects is required.
• Previous professional experience working with informal settlements is required.
• Previous academic or professional experience working with the 2030 Agenda and NUA is desirable.
• Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
• Good handling of technological tools, such as Microsoft Windows and Microsoft Office, is required.
• Strong facilitation and communication skills, particularly with children and diverse community groups are required.
• Ability to design and apply age-appropriate, creative and participatory methodologies is required.
• Capacity to systematize qualitative information and produce clear technical reports aligned with institutional standards is required.
• Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and public institutions is desirable. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required. Working knowledge of Spanish and English is desirable.

Additional Information

Travel details: The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. Fundada em 1977 como "Cardiolab", atualmente conta com 75 hospitais próprios e 3 sob gestão, além de 55 clínicas oncológicas, nos estados do RJ, SP, MG, PE, BA, MA, SE, CE, AL, PB, PR, MS, PA e DF.

Acreditamos na responsabilidade em contribuir para uma sociedade mais justa, inclusiva e com igualdade de oportunidades, por isso, todas as nossas vagas estão abertas a pessoas de diferentes perfis e contextos, inclusive pessoas com deficiência.

description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar a recepção de pacientes e familiares, fornecendo informações claras sobre o funcionamento do serviço, horários e documentos necessários.

Coletar dados básicos e documentos necessários para o cadastro de novos usuários.

Registrar a presença de usuários e profissionais, gerando relatórios de faltas ou evasão para acompanhamento da coordenação.

Atuar de forma empática no atendimento de reclamações ou dúvidas, encaminhando questões complexas para a equipe multiprofissional ou coordenação.

Servir de elo entre a equipe técnica e a administração, transmitindo comunicados, escalas de plantão e alterações de normas internas.

Auxiliar na tramitação administrativa de laudos, declarações de comparecimento e encaminhamentos internos/externos.

Deter domínio técnico em diversos sistemas de informação (SIS), com foco na otimização de processos internos e suporte à tomada de decisão.

Controlar o estoque de materiais de escritório, materiais de limpeza e insumos básicos de reabilitação, realizando pedidos de reposição e conferência de notas fiscais.

Elaborar planilhas de indicadores (número de atendimentos, altas, novos ingressos) para suporte à direção da unidade.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior em andamento, com, no mínimo, 02 semestres concluídos, nos cursos de Administração de Empresas, Administração Hospitalar, Gestão de Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada com rotinas administrativas.

Informações adicionais

Local: Irajá

Horário de Trabalho: 40h semanais

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados.
